visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black-rimmed glasses and a black t-shirt stands in a room filled with anime posters and shelves of collectibles. He is holding a microphone with a yellow 'HahaTai' tag. A woman is partially visible beside him. (2) The camera cuts to a extreme close-up of a striped leopard gecko peeking out from a stone-textured hideout on a grey substrate. (3) The scene shifts to show multiple stacked transparent plastic reptile enclosures, each containing various miniature landscapes, fake plants, and small hides. (4) Close-up of a white and black spotted gecko crawling slowly past a pair of tiny yellow toy shoes inside its enclosure. (5) The man holds an orange and white banded gecko in his hands, showing it to the interviewers. (6) Two other young men (hosts) are shown reacting with expressive facial expressions in a medium shot. (7) A close-up of a light-colored gecko looking directly at the camera. A yellow smiley face emoji is overlaid above its head. (8) The gecko is shown in profile, staring ahead with a neutral or slightly grumpy expression while a text box appears at the bottom.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 哈哈台 HahaTai. [Subtitle]: 有什麼是你開始養守宮以後. (2) [Subtitle]: 才發現...欸 原來這種動物有什麼特別的地方. (3) [Subtitle]: 像大家都會覺得可能 爬蟲、蛇那些就是. (4) [Subtitle]: 沒有接觸的人會覺得很恐怖. (5) [Subtitle]: 但是其實牠們就是很可愛. (6) [Subtitle]: 我們這邊是 主要是以肥尾守宮、肥尾 跟豹紋守宮. (7) [Variety]: 亂講人家. (8) [Subtitle]: (胖胖的好可愛). (9) [Subtitle]: 因為它看起來屁股很胖啊-很肥. (10) [Subtitle]: 肥尾的話會更...屁股會更肥. (11) [Subtitle]: 牠很喜歡躲起來. (12) [Subtitle]: 欸欸真的很大家耶. (13) [Subtitle]: (好可愛). (14) [Subtitle]: 牠看起來很像...就是很像玩具. (15) [Subtitle]: 豆瓣醬-牠叫豆瓣醬. (16) [Subtitle]: 養貓通常大家會養一隻或是兩隻嘛. (17) [Subtitle]: 那通常這個守宮...會是養幾隻啊-牠們不能在一起嗎. (18) [Subtitle]: 因為牠們是有領地性. (19) [Subtitle]: 所以牠們其實獨居的-對獨居. (20) [Subtitle]: 那為什麼會養到八隻啊. (21) [Subtitle]: 通常養守宮的人都有這個煩惱. (22) [Slogan]: 就是養一隻. (23) [Slogan]: 然後牠會 細胞分裂成兩隻. (24) [Slogan]: 守宮這麼厲害是不是. (25) [Slogan]: 守宮會無性繁殖. (26) [Variety]: (幹話太多). (27) [Subtitle]: 你說牠斷掉的尾巴 其實可以長出新的來. (28) [Subtitle]: 大家真的...在看這集真的以為是這樣-對. (29) [Subtitle]: 但養守宮你們獲得的成就感是什麼. (30) [Subtitle]: 養守宮的最大的情緒價值就是. (31) [Subtitle]: 因為守宮都會微笑. (32) [Subtitle]: 所以你看著牠就很開心. (33) [Subtitle]: 你說牠本來的臉就是笑臉. (34) [Subtitle]: 像我們看這一隻. (35) [Subtitle]: 這一隻是我們第一隻. (36) [Subtitle]: 欸 原來牠是第一隻喔 牠叫什麼. (37) [Subtitle]: 牠叫豆奶. (38) [Subtitle]: 牠就是牠的嘴巴其實都是微笑. (39) [Variety]: 有嗎!? 我覺得牠現在沒有在笑喔. (40) [Subtitle]: 牠眼神長得比較兇. (41) [Slogan]: 休對本宮無禮.
